outputs.headline: Scam: No PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026 exists
outputs.summary: The Indian government has not announced any 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'; messages about it are a scam to steal personal information.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is providing free laptops to all students from the government.
outputs.what_is_true: The Government of India has not announced a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. Messages promoting this are a scam designed to steal personal information. While some state governments have their own laptop schemes, no such national program exists.
evidence_against: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check stated that no such program has been announced by the Government of India.
Livemint reported on September 21, 2026, that PIB Fact Check clarified these claims are fake and a scam.
Vishvas News and FACTLY have rated similar claims about government free laptop schemes as false.
outputs.sources_spoken: the Press Information Bureau and Livemint
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is giving free laptops to all students from the government. This is a scam. The Government of India has not announced any such scheme. Messages about this are designed to steal your personal information. While some state governments have their own laptop schemes, there is no national program like this. We are very sure about this. This information comes from the Press Information Bureau and Livemint.
card_lines: SCAM: No PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026
Claim: Government giving free laptops to all students.
Fact: This is a scam to steal personal data.
Source: PIB Fact Check

Vishvas News rated as false the claim that free laptops would be given under a free laptop scheme, noting a clickbait link went viral.

We are very sure about this. This information comes from newsonair.gov.in, Livemint, and Vishvas News, all of whom have debunked this claim.
